securityChecks.canonicalName: AI Output to Dynamic Code Execution
securityChecks.securityProposition: THE CHECK PROVES: AI/LLM model output flows to a dynamic code execution sink (eval, exec, os.system, os.popen, new Function). BECAUSE: Semgrep taint mode tracks from AI invocation sources (openai.chat.completions.create, anthropic.messages.create, $LLM.invoke, $LLM.predict, $LLM.generate, $CHAIN.run, $CHAIN.invoke) to dangerous code execution sinks.
limitations: Taint tracking is limited by Semgrep's intra-file, pattern-based analysis.
May miss flows through complex data structures or cross-file assignments.
May have false negatives on indirect flows.
Does not detect AI output flowing to subprocess.run or subprocess.Popen (future detector).
